criteria.requirement: Resources require explicit lifecycle classes and stable ownership; validate host/image/provider/OS/firmware compatibility.
Bootstrap carries SecretRef.ID only; unknown/raw secret fields and unsafe public connections fail; execution requests cannot be serialized.
Runtime, availability, drift, health and ownership are independent; unavailable observations preserve the last runtime state/time; stale generations/sessions/sequences fail.
Resources persist with tenant scope, immutable creation/image identity, generation CAS, normalized collections and transactional revision snapshots.
Host/org admission serializes quota races; reservations require fresh provider capacity, remain for stopped VMs and never double-count plane jobs.
Idempotency returns the original operation; conflicting content and overlapping mutations fail; unconfirmed retains exclusivity.
Two-person, bounded, request/generation/fingerprint-bound approvals are consumed atomically and once; failures roll back desired state, capacity, approval and journal.
Cold checkpoint manifests contain required disk/kernel/rootfs/NVRAM/swtpm components; committed manifests freeze; exports preserve content hashes/sizes.
Plane capability requires fresh authenticated current-generation/session probe evidence with exact pins; failed, stale, reordered, altered duplicate and Windows probes cannot grant eligibility.
Pilot profile revision 1 uses explicit byte ranges and 16 vCPU/64 GiB/220 GiB aggregate ceiling, with no implicit Windows allocation.
Migration 000066 applies up/down without altering legacy deployment-unit rows; rollback refuses inventory/history loss.
Build, targeted vet, domain/repository tests and real PostgreSQL integration tests pass.
